### struct `Runner`

The `runner:` block: exactly one kind — a `script` (a shell command) or a `docker` container. Declaring **both** is a config error: `Hive::runners` refuses to launch it (it is skipped, with a warning) rather than guess which was meant. A block with neither is likewise skipped (there is nothing to launch).

```rust
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Deserialize)]
pub struct Runner {
    #[serde(default)]
    pub script: Option<Script>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub docker: Option<Docker>,
}
```

### struct `Docker`

A container runner — an "irregular Docker Compose" service: one container, declared with the familiar compose-ish keys, but supervised by adi-hive rather than by `docker compose`. It compiles (see `Docker::command_line`) to an **attach-to-existing** command: `docker start` the named container (a running one is a no-op — never a restart), create it only if it doesn't exist, then `docker wait` it so adi-hive supervises the container's lifetime without owning it. A supervisor restart leaves the container running (stop it with `docker stop <name>`); a container that exits on its own is relaunched per the restart policy.

```rust
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Deserialize)]
pub struct Docker {
    pub image: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub command: Option<Vec<String>>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub ports: BTreeMap<String, u16>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub volumes: Vec<String>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub environment: BTreeMap<String, String>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub pull: Option<String>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub args: Vec<String>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub name: Option<String>,
}
```

### enum `Decision`

Where a request goes once its `Host` (and target) have been matched. Separate from the act of connecting so the decision is a pure function the tests — and the mesh gateway, which reuses this table — can exercise without a socket.

```rust
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Decision {
    Service(SocketAddr),
    Mesh(SocketAddr),
    MeshUnavailable,
    NoRoute,
}
```

### struct `Router`

The `(host, path) → upstream` routing table. Shared through a `watch` channel so the config reloader can hot-swap it: a service added on disk (with a `proxy.host`) starts routing without a front-door restart. Each connection snapshots the current table, so an in-flight proxy keeps its own.

```rust
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Router {
    routes: Vec<Route>,
    mesh_gateway: Option<SocketAddr>,
}
```
